title: NDVI departure from the same month, 2019 to 2025 (monthly_departure 1.0.0)
description:
Precomputed result of recipe monthly_departure 1.0.0 on bundle_s2_ndvi_monthly_ait_bouguemez: 58 of 84 periods have a departure. The reference is a short period (2019 to 2025), not a climate normal. A departure describes how this month differs from other years here; it does not say why. The spatial IQR is variability across pixels, not a confidence interval. In winter months the accepted pixels favour the valley floor and south-facing slopes, because snow and shade remove the others; the area value then describes those pixels, not the whole catchment.

Revision 13 (2026-10-27). Among duplicates of a tile and date, an item with no clear pixels over the catchment is now skipped when a twin has some. That clause was added to the duplicate rule after data was first read; the rule fixed before any data was read kept the newest processing baseline only. Revision 12, the first committed, has no version field; it documented the clause but kept the newest item, so it kept an item with 0 clear pixels over the catchment on seven tile-dates: 29RQQ 2019-04-17 (twin had 285 clear pixels), 2019-06-21 (702,669), 2020-11-12 (84), 2021-06-07 (8), 2021-11-19 (8), 2021-12-22 (8), and 29SQR 2020-10-23 (16). In five cases the twin is an older baseline (02.14, 03.00, 03.01), so its clear pixels come from an older scene classification. This revision recomputes 2019-04, 2019-06, 2020-10, 2020-11, 2021-06, 2021-11 and 2021-12 and everything derived from them; no NDVI or departure area median moved at four decimals.

Revision 14 (2026-10-27). The leave-one-year-out measurements of 2019-03 and 2020-03, which revision 13 excluded without saying why, now carry a missing_reason (Siterra STAC extension 1.1.0): pixels with a value that year and a reference from at least 4 other years cover too little of the catchment, below the 70% coverage policy. No value, status or count changed. Only this bundle is revised; the aligned bundle's link to it is re-pinned, and its results are unchanged.

Revision 15 (2026-10-28). Each period whose leave-one-year-out departure is available (56 of 84) gains a display raster for the map, asset overview: that period's per-pixel leave-one-year-out departure, averaged into 30 m Web Mercator cells (about 25.5 m on the ground here) and painted on the fixed scale -0.10 to +0.10 with the light-theme NDVI departure ramp, lossless WebP. It is for display only; every number shown comes from the measurements. 2019-03 and 2020-03, whose leave-one-year-out value is excluded, and the periods without a departure have no display raster. The Collection also lists the mapped cropland and buildings (ESA WorldCover 2021 classes 40 and 50) of the terrain strata bundle as polygons, for the map's hatch; no value is masked by them. No value, status or count changed. Only this bundle is revised; the aligned bundle's link to it is re-pinned, and its results are unchanged.

providers.name: Siterra science pipeline
providers.processing:lineage: Deduplicated tile-date items (newest baseline), DN/10000 without offset, scene classification classes 4 and 5 kept, NDVI per observation, same-date tiles merged, per-pixel monthly median and date count, acceptance policy, area summaries over the frozen catchment (docs/reference/observation-preprocessing.md). Display rasters: the leave-one-year-out departure grid averaged into 30 m EPSG:3857 cells and painted with the light-theme data.ndvi-departure ramp on its fixed scale, t in 16 steps, lossless WebP; mapped cropland and buildings from the terrain strata bundle's excluded band, polygonized.

excluded_land.title: Mapped cropland and buildings (ESA WorldCover 2021 classes 40 and 50), for the map's hatch (display only)
excluded_land.description: The excluded layer of bundle_terrain_strata_ait_bouguemez (51,134 pixels of 10 m, from WorldCover's 10 m map) as polygons in EPSG:4326, coordinates at 5 decimals. A 2021 context mask, not a field survey; no departure value is masked by it.

siterra:dataset.access_route: Earth Search STAC API https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/, collection sentinel-2-l2a (legacy), COGs on sentinel-cogs.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com read by window

siterra:geo_selection.area_method: Count of 10 m analysis pixels whose centres fall inside the frozen polygon, EPSG:32629

operation_order: NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red), surface reflectance = DN / 10000, per clear observation
N(p, y, m) = median of NDVI over the clear dates of pixel p in month m of year y, used only where accepted(p, t) = 1
ref(p, m) = median of N(p, y, m) over the years 2019 to 2025 in which it exists; defined only with at least 4 such years
ref_loyo(p, y, m) = the same median over the years other than y; defined only with at least 4 such years
dep(p, y, m) = N(p, y, m) - ref(p, m); dep_loyo(p, y, m) = N(p, y, m) - ref_loyo(p, y, m)
common-valid pixels: dep(p, y, m) defined; the month's summary is withheld if they cover less than 70% of the catchment
summary = area median of dep over common-valid pixels, with spatial IQR (25th to 75th percentile); the same for dep_loyo

siterra:checks.name: period_alignment
siterra:checks.detail: Each departure Item uses the NDVI Item of the same period ID and the same geometry revision

siterra:checks.name: nodata_not_zero
siterra:checks.detail: Pixels without an accepted value or without a reference stay NaN; periods below the coverage policy carry no value. In the display rasters, cells without a value are transparent, never painted as zero

siterra:checks.name: units_and_scale
siterra:checks.detail: Departures in NDVI index units (1), no percentages

siterra:checks.name: recompute_sample_period
siterra:checks.detail: Deterministic from the validated NDVI composites; the NDVI bundle's own recompute check covers the inputs. Display rasters: the 2025-11 grids of both references, recomputed from the NDVI composites, are pixel-identical to the grids rendered; all 168 grid statistics (valid pixel count, area median and spatial IQR, both references) equal the stored measurements; the cropland and buildings polygons rasterize back to the strata bundle's excluded band exactly (51,134 pixels)

siterra:checks.name: attribution_present
siterra:checks.detail: Source attributions carried from the NDVI bundle. ESA WorldCover attribution and licence added for the cropland and buildings layer
